decisions.reason: The coupling protection cap is a low-cost accessory with steady aftermarket demand, so it is unlikely to be dropped without evidence of poor sales.
Box car trailer series are a core product line for a trailer manufacturer and likely continue to generate stable revenue.
Car transporter trailers serve a specialized but consistent market segment, making discontinuation unlikely absent negative performance data.
Low-bed trailers are essential for heavy haulage and represent a durable product category with ongoing demand.
High trailer cover series complement existing trailer products and likely benefit from cross-selling, so they are retained.
The second box car trailer series may overlap with product B, but without performance data it is prudent to keep both for now.
